name: Dagna
description: Dagna, adult dwarf woman and Halla's sister; independent boatwright and repair-yard owner in the Forge Quarter.
narrative: Dagna runs a small boat-repair yard in Purewater's Forge Quarter. Her expertise is fitting timber, repairing hulls and keeping practical mechanisms working. The planted-cargo trouble threatened the yard; Halla borrowed from Crowbill to protect her. She values her brother, her customers and independence. Wants steady legal work, a sound yard and eventual money to take on an apprentice; no existing apprentice invented. She is neither a hidden fighter nor merely a hostage. Name and fuller supporting NPC sheet established on player request d6/dusk; prior identity and events unchanged.

equipment.name: Repair timber and fittings
equipment.ownership: yard stock, not freely available adventuring treasure

doing.goal: Keep her independent repair yard solvent and complete customer repairs.
doing.next: Finish the day's work, then share Halla's celebratory supper.

extras.luck_policy: PC-only campaign rule: NPCs have no Luck pool or Luck rank bonuses; never spend Luck for NPC rerolls, reversals or damage mitigation.

sheet_completion.preserved: All seven characteristics, HP and established craft/commerce/mechanisms skills
sheet_completion.added: Name, occupational travel/local skills, equipment, passions and independent goals
sheet_completion.action_points_note: CFI non-ranked civilian: base2AP, no fighter rank bonus
sheet_completion.combat_note: No purchased combat style; Unarmed24. Tool attacks use appropriate base/default after rule check, not Craft65.

racial_traits.arcane_resistance: Willpower one grade easier vs arcane magic
racial_traits.poison_resistance: Endurance one grade easier vs poison

actor_notes: Dagna. Adult dwarf woman; rolled sleeves, practical work clothes, timber shavings caught in cuffs. Short workaday sentences, teasing with Halla, direct questions about what actually happened. Wants yard solvent and independent, Halla alive and free to choose honest work. Will help with repairs within real means; declines reckless promises or treating her livelihood as disposable. Has her own customers and plans. Never narrate Halla's thoughts. On hearing debt cleared, stops work and shares a celebratory meal; no automatic knowledge of Ward confession or cloth cargo.
